dogecoin.text: Not saying they’re wrong for doing so. Let’s not pretend that $DOGE is some holy crusade. That’s a rad ridiculous, IMO.

It sucks that people likely lost money because of $DOGE taking a dive. But I’m going to be honest, every person I actually know who has bought $DOGE, doesn’t give too shits about $DOGE itself. They want quick and easy money. Let’s not pretend it’s anything else other than that.
